---
name: Enhancement or RFC
about: Propose user value before selecting implementation
title: "feat: "
labels: enhancement
---

## User value

Who needs this capability and what outcome would improve?

## Proposed scope and non-goals

Describe the smallest useful increment and explicit exclusions.

## Specification

Link the applicable docs/specs proposal, or write "Unknown".

## Constraints and alternatives

Include compatibility and security considerations without secrets.

## Triage (maintainer)

Track C unless investigation establishes otherwise. Record owner, roadmap link,
dependencies and scheduling. Backlog placement does not authorize implementation.
